b-005.reason: auſquelles = auxquelles, 'to whom' (the persons to whom they belong by kinship); auſquelbes is no word, a misread of l as b.

n-g-0.reason: l. ſi vicinus is at least a word (the law is C. 5.4.9 Si vicinis, cited correctly as ſi vicinis in note b on the same page); vicinu is a broken form; the citation is the same either way.
